---
title: "VS Code"
---

Install Visual Studio Code for editing code, documentation, and lab automation files.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags vscode
```

## Quarto screenshots

The role installs the Quarto and Markdown Paste extensions and `xclip` for Linux
clipboard access. In a local `.qmd` file, `Ctrl+Alt+V` saves a screenshot under
`images/` beside the document and inserts a relative Markdown image reference.

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

1. Open a `.qmd` file in VS Code.
2. Copy a screenshot to the clipboard.
3. Press `Ctrl+Alt+V`.
4. Confirm that an image appears under `images/`.
5. Confirm that a Markdown image reference was inserted.
:::
